content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications via email/offline is 18th August 2026. However, walk-in interviews are conducted on the 18th of every month.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Faculty and Senior Residents?
faq.answer: There are a total of 77 vacancies available for Teaching Faculty and Senior Residents posts in ESIC Medical College & Hospital Indore.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 69 years. Age relaxation is applicable for Senior Resident posts as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Professor post is Rs. 123100.00 per month, which is a fixed basic pay as per the 7th CPC, Pay Level 13.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for all posts is as per the National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an interview before the Selection Board and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ESIC Medical College & Hospital located?
faq.answer: ESIC Medical College & Hospital is located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 452011.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for these posts is Contractual.
